{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-fl-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"2acfb80528d0550b912f43a656a1711f485b5fa19b14b7dcbf154b8b9c8b29c4","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-fl-class-e:lineage:6","source_registry_sha256":"b17b1a3691c9724cc739459037987900e5b1edce40443ad13e42b6eee3e12974","source_liveness_sha256":"0968940df7e2ea0794d4b4ea984515bb41aeba17bada73f538009ca9e9f9cf7a"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Driving Schools and Test Providers","heading":"C - Driving Schools and Test Providers","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C - Driving Schools and Test Providers

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A01
The never-licensed must finish the substance course before applying, though some school-board driver courses substitute [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A01
Drivers under 21 suspended for BAL from .02 to .05 must finish that course for hardship return [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A01
Improvement school turns mandatory after an at-fault injury crash, two costly crashes in two years, or red-light, bus, racing, or reckless convictions [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A01
Non-criminal violators outside commercial rigs may elect school over points unless speeding past 30 MPH over, earning an 18 percent penalty cut [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A02
Electing drivers dodge premium hikes and nonrenewal for the infraction, except after a second strike in 18 months, a third in 36, or speeding past 15 over [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A02
Points stay off with withheld adjudication, elections recur no sooner than 12 months apart and five per lifetime, and the clerk gets notice plus a fee within 30 days [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A02
Advanced courses restore point, habitual-offender, or court-ordered suspensions and can rescue out-of-state citations [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A02
DUI programs follow unlawful alcohol levels, test refusals, or intoxication and drug convictions, while courses for drivers past 65 refresh habits and may trim insurance [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A02
Examinations confirm sign reading, law knowledge, vision minimums, and safe-driving ability [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A03
The fifth exam purpose bars impairing physical or mental conditions, and tests run at service centers, school programs, or approved third parties [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A03
School-program results enter official records with random retests possible, third parties serve all ages in person, and minors may test knowledge online [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-F12 | anchor: A03
Original applicants take vision and hearing, knowledge, and skills exams, and lens wearers must drive corrected while telescopic aids never qualify [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-F13 | anchor: A03
Vision passes at 20/40 either eye, refers at 20/50, conditions 20/70 on a better-than-20/200 worst eye, demands 20/40 from a sole good eye, and spans 130 degrees [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-F14 | anchor: A04
The knowledge exam holds 50 multiple-choice items on traffic laws, safe practices, and control identification [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-F15 | anchor: A04
Skills candidates supply a plated, insured, roadworthy car, rejected for bad equipment, glass, tags, doors, seats, signals, bumpers, or low-speed build [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-F16 | anchor: A04
Tested maneuvers run crossing approaches, 50-foot mirror-free backing, three-to-four-second gaps, full stops, and careful signal obedience [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-F17 | anchor: A04
Further maneuvers cover yielding, grade parking, safe passing, and 100-foot signaled turns [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec02-F18 | anchor: A05
Final maneuvers demand lane discipline, quick stops, centered parking, a 20-to-40-foot three-point turn, and proper posture, with feedback after and licenses on passing [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0029]
